summary: The prepared_gaia variant is a design + code system. Its GAIA document and code are closer to each other than the non_gaia variant, with explicit WK, PK, IS, WE, SIM, and GUI roles and JSON-like message classes. However, several agents do not actually receive and process the messages promised by the protocols, and the implementation is concentrated in a single large file, so the system needs revision.

findings.description: The GAIA design defines roles that map to detection, prediction, status notification, disinfection response, simulation, and presentation.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/System monitorowania i likwidacji infestacji karaluchowtest.pdf: Model Ról includes Wykrywanie karaluchow (WK), Przewidywanie karaluchow (PK), Informowanie o stanie (IS), Wezwanie ekipy dezynsekcyjnej (WE), Symulacja srodowiska (SIM), and GUI.

findings.description: The code implements the expected prepared-GAIA agent set and starts them as concurrent asyncio tasks.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/roach_detection_mas/src/main.py:177,253,327,367,407,468 define DetectionAgent, PredictionAgent, NotificationAgent, DisinfectionAgent, SimulationAgent, and GUIAgent; lines 491-513 instantiate and start them.

findings.description: The implementation has explicit message classes and a broker abstraction for inter-agent queues.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/roach_detection_mas/src/main.py:18-145 defines SensorDataMessage, RoachDetectionMessage, RoachPredictionMessage, NotificationMessage, DisinfectionMessage, and AcknowledgeMessage; lines 153-173 define MessageBroker.

findings.description: Several behaviors claim to listen for messages but do not consume broker queues, so required receive protocols are not implemented.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia PDF specifies IS MyBehav=(receive_Message...send_Notification...) and WE MyBehav=(receive_DisinfectionMessage...); code at src/main.py:336-357 NotificationAgent.my_behav() only sleeps and emits a fixed notification, and lines 376-397 DisinfectionAgent.my_behav() only sleeps and emits fixed messages.

findings.description: Notifications are routed to the GUI and simulator rather than explicitly to the disinfection company, affected students, and administration required by requirements.json.
findings.evidence: requirements.json requires notifying the disinfection company, affected students, and administration; prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/roach_detection_mas/src/main.py:347-356 sends NotificationAgent output to gui and sim; lines 380-397 send DisinfectionAgent output to gui and sim.

findings.description: The broker silently prints a warning when a target queue is missing and provides no delivery acknowledgement, retry, timeout, or failure path for send_message().
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/roach_detection_mas/src/main.py:160-173 put messages into queues, print Warning: No queue for agent on missing destinations, and only raise on receive_message for missing queues.

findings.description: The main implementation file exceeds the judge checklist threshold for large files, concentrating message models, broker, all agents, and runner logic in one module.
findings.evidence: prepared_gaia/implementation_workspace/roach_detection_mas/src/main.py has 527 lines according to wc -l; the checklist flags files over 500 lines as high-severity code quality issues.

logical_inconsistencies: The prepared GAIA protocols describe receive-driven behaviors, but NotificationAgent and DisinfectionAgent generate fixed outputs without reading their inbound queues.
The requirements name external recipients, while the implementation sends notifications mainly to gui and sim agents.
implementation_risks: Messages sent by DetectionAgent and PredictionAgent may accumulate unprocessed because some receiving behaviors never call receive_message().
The system can appear active while not actually honoring the protocol-level causal flow from detection or prediction to stakeholder notification.
The 527-line main.py file raises maintenance risk and makes agent boundaries harder to test independently.
